en: The young dollmaker would always be surrounded by her dolls. They were all she cared about. Making dolls, playing with dolls, taking care of her dolls. These dolls were her children and they would protect their mother from any threat that would approach her. To say these dolls are alive is anyone's guess.

en: ''This is Bunbunmaru News.... I.... The war is going... badly for us right now. Another four of my colleagues were shot down by flak this week. The humans have been increasing their air raids on us and moving up their guns so they can hit us closer near the mountain. Megumu told me we just need to hold out a little longer, but I don't know anymore. The fact that I'm the one leading the Crow Tengu in combat already tells us how bad things are. Usually it'd be one of the older ones leading them, but they're... gone now. I think I need to talk to Momiji again.''
ko: ''여기는 분분마루 신문... 나... 전세가... 지금은 우리에게 좋지 않아. 이번 주에 동료 네 명이 대공포에 격추됐어. 인간들이 우리에게 공습을 늘리고 산 근처로 포를 전진시켜서 더 가까이 맞출 수 있게 됐어. 메구무는 조금만 더 버티면 된다고 했지만, 이젠 나도 모르겠어. 까마귀 텐구를 이끄는 게 벌써 나라는 사실 자체가 사태가 얼마나 나쁜지 보여주는 거야. 보통은 연장자가 이끌지만, 그분들은... 이제 없으니까. 모미지와 다시 얘기해 봐야겠어.''

en: ''It's hard to imagine what the Lunarians were thinking of having their soldiers wear suits into combat rather than traditional armor. Though then again, maybe there's something special about these suits that they aren't telling us. After all, they're still wearing them today.''

''You're telling me that frilly pink skirt is all you're going to be wearing into combat?! Are you moon rabbits always this insane? I don't care if it's 'magical', go get some damn pants and body armor!''

asset: A traditional Moon Rabbit skirt that was used by the Lunarians.

en: ''You're a fool. A idiot. To think you would give up paradise cause of your own selfishness. Fine. If you're going to be like that, then I guess I'll have to stay with you to make sure you don't do anything stupid.''
ko: ''바보야. 멍청이야. 자기 이기심 때문에 낙원을 포기하겠다고? 좋아. 그렇게 나온다면, 네가 바보 같은 짓 하지 않도록 내가 같이 지켜봐 줄 수밖에 없겠네.''

en: ''After having been attacked countless times despite her insistence of only being a messenger. The oarfish would eventually take up training with a weapon and be able to defend herself from zealous youkai or humans who are too blind for their own good.''
ko: ''사신이라고만 주장하던 그녀가 수없이 공격을 받은 끝에, 산갈치는 결국 무기 수련을 시작해 지나치게 열심인 요괴나 눈먼 인간들로부터 스스로를 지킬 수 있게 됐다.''

en: ''Her duty is to simply observe and deliver messages. That is all what an envoy of the Dragon Palace does. Yet despite that, she finds her duties revolving around the celestial outcast becoming more and more prevalent as her family constantly ordered to keep delivering letters to the outcast and monitering her.''
ko: ''관찰하고 전언을 전하는 것. 그게 용궁 사자가 하는 일의 전부다. 그런데도 그녀는 가족이 끊임없이 전언을 전하고 감시하라 명하면서, 그 내쫓긴 천인과 관련된 임무가 점점 늘어가는 것을 느낀다.''

en: ''Unlike the other natives, the oarfish did not miss her old home as much as the others did for she had little connections with those who lived below. The only one she did have some relationship on the ground with was with the celestial outcast who came with her to their new home due to her family's insistence. Like back at home, she is the sole messenger responsible on keeping an eye of that celestial where ever she goes.''
ko: ''다른 토착민들과 달리, 산갈치는 아래에서 살았던 이들과 인연이 거의 없었기에 옛 고향을 그리워하지 않았다. 지상에서 인연이 있던 유일한 존재는 가족의 주장으로 그녀와 함께 새 집으로 온 그 내쫓긴 천인뿐이었다. 고향에서처럼, 그녀는 그 천인이 어디를 가든 눈을 떼지 않는 유일한 전언자다.''

en: Kappas often carry large backpacks reminiscent of their ancestor's shells. These backpacks would carry hundreds of tools, half finished contraptions, and whatever else a Kappa would want to shove in there. While a human would likely crumble under the immense weight of these massive packs, a Kappa has no problem hauling around their entire workshop everywhere they go.

field:

en: A uniform that belongs to a certain type of youkai that refer themselves as Kappas. Unlike most youkai, Kappas are well versed in technology and are naturally curious about it. While most Kappa prefer to work alone, some may find human company to be worthwhile. Perhaps that is why they too wander the stars like the other races.
ko: 스스로를 캇파라 부르는 요괴 종족의 제복. 대부분의 요괴와 달리 캇파는 기술에 정통하고 본능적으로 호기심이 많다. 대부분의 캇파는 혼자 일하는 걸 좋아하지만, 인간의 동행이 가치 있다고 생각하는 이도 있다. 그래서인지 그들도 다른 종족처럼 별들을 떠돌고 있다.

en: In the old legends, Kappas were once considered youkai responsible for drowning unsuspecting humans near rivers and floods. Recent stories however refute these claims and consider the youkai as a ally of humanity rather than a threat. From building dams to prevent flooding to offering their expertise to those looking for help, many human colonies who encountered such beings think of them fondly after their encounter.
ko: 옛 전설에서 캇파는 강과 범람 근처에서 눈치 없는 인간을 익사시키는 요괴로 여겨졌다. 그러나 최근 이야기들은 그런 주장을 반박하며 요괴를 위협이 아닌 인류의 동맹으로 본다. 홍수를 막는 둑을 쌓아주고 도움을 구하는 이에게 지식을 나눠주는 등, 이런 존재들과 만난 인간 식민지 대부분은 그들을 좋은 기억으로 남기게 됐다.

field: 산을 향한 진격이 교착되고 요괴가 일반적인 군사 전술을 인간 군대에 쓰기 시작하자, 사기는 곤두박질치고 병참은 양군 모두에게 커다란 난제가 됐다. 장교들은 친위 분대와 함께 최전선으로 나서, 보급 부족과 끊임없는 공격 속에서도 전선을 지키려 했다.\n^#698f78;직속 경비병 [가슴]: ^reset;^orange;배치 명령^reset;^#698f78; 사용 시 라이온 대대 유탄병 1명 소환 | 재사용 대기 30초.\n+20% 회피. 방어력: +20% 출혈^reset;

en: Officers of the battalion are often found in the front maintaining morale and issuing new orders. As the war dragged on and morale began plummetting, officers had to do their best to inspire soldiers and keep them focused as the tengu inflicted massive casualties using new tactics that they learned over the war.

asset: ^#698f78;Personal Guards [HEAD]: Summons one LION BATTALION GRENADIER when using a ^reset;^orange;DEPLOYMENT ORDER^reset;^#698f78; | 60s Cooldown.
Inspiring Presence: Nearby INFANTRY SUMMONS gain +25% General Weapon Proficiency. +12.5% DODGE Chance.^reset;
field: 대대의 장교들은 사기를 유지하고 새 명령을 전달하며 자주 최전선에서 발견된다. 전쟁이 길어지고 사기가 곤두박질치자, 텐구가 전쟁 중 익힌 새 전술로 입히는 막대한 사상자 속에서도 장교들은 병사들을 격려하고 집중시키려 최선을 다했다.\n^#698f78;직속 경비병 [머리]: ^reset;^orange;배치 명령^reset;^#698f78; 사용 시 라이온 대대 유탄병 1명 소환 | 재사용 대기 60초.\n고무적 존재감: 주변 보병 소환물이 일반 무기 숙련 +25%. +12.5% 회피.^reset;

en: ''You can raise them as if everything is normal, but there will always be some folks who sees through the lies you give them.''

asset: When it comes to technological levels, the rabbit youkai are the most advanced. While majority of the youkai including the tengu remain 'archaic' in their advancement of science, the rabbit youkai are anything but that. It is only because of lack of material as well as distrust toward the other youkai that they cannot overpower the human armies.

field: ''다들 정상인 척 키울 수는 있어. 하지만 네가 지어낸 거짓말을 꿰뚫어 보는 놈들은 언제나 있게 마련이야.''\n기술 수준으로 보면 토끼 요괴가 가장 앞서 있다. 텐구를 포함한 대부분의 요괴가 과학 발전에서 '구식'인 반면, 토끼 요괴는 전혀 그렇지 않다. 자재 부족과 다른 요괴에 대한 불신만 아니라면 인간 군대를 능가할 수도 있었다.\n^#a59477;+25HP.^reset;

en: Using whatever metals they can get their hands on, the rabbit youkai created what can only be described as armor between eras. These metal chestplates and straps follow modern vest designs such as mag pouches and holsters, but is still a chestplate you'd see on a knight.

asset: ^#a59477;Rabbit's Trauma [COURAGE] [3-SET BONUS]: Start with -10% General Weapon Proficiency which slowly goes up to a +50% bonus. Taking damage reduces the bonus by -20% per hit. (+2%/sec)^reset;

field: 손에 잡히는 금속은 뭐든 써서, 토끼 요괴는 시대를 넘나든 갑옷이라 부를 수밖에 없는 것을 만들어냈다. 이 금속 흉갑과 끈은 탄창 파우치와 홀스터 같은 현대식 조끼 설계를 따르지만, 기사 갑옷에서 볼 법한 흉갑이기도 하다.\n^#a59477;토끼의 트라우마 [용기] [3세트 보너스]: 일반 무기 숙련 -10%로 시작해 서서히 +50% 보너스까지 상승. 피격 시 타격당 보너스 -20%. (초당 +2%)^reset;\n^#a59477;방어력: +25% 소화기 | +20% 참격 & 타격 | +10% 찌르기^reset;

en: ''You call it desertion. We call it survival. Why should I die for someone who doesn't care for me?''

asset: It is unknown when these rabbits deserted their masters, but it is likely over hundreds of years ago by now. As far as the locals is concerned, they are just normal rabbit youkai and nothing more. Just the way they like it.

en: ''Technology only amplifies destruction. Humanity proves that.''

asset: They didn't hate humanity but rather distrusted them due to how often they were betrayed for their technology. Backstabs and lies have made the rabbits extremely paranoid of humans though not completely hostile as there are a few that have shown their trust to be genuine compared to many others.

en: ''I won't die here! To hell with the humans! To hell with the tengu! I am going to stay alive!''

asset: A light vest that offers little protection, but is light.
^#a59477;LED Light: Emits a small light around the player.^reset;
^#a59477;Rabbit's Trauma [SURVIVOR] [3-SET BONUS]: Gain 3 stacks of +60% DODGE Chance. Taking damage removes a stack of DODGE. Each stack of a DODGE Chance has a independant 20s Cooldown.^reset;

en: ''We needed to find a new home. This would have to do.''

asset: Nobody knows when these rabbit youkai showed up. While it's not out of the ordinary for a new youkai to appear over time, an entire family appearing overnight is something even the tengu would find extremely suspicious. The allure of money and technology however can stifle even the most suspicous eyes if given to the right people.

en: ''You call us cowards, but we've fought more wars than any of you. In none of those wars has charging the enemy head on worked.''

asset: ^#a59477;Rabbit's Trauma [ARMORER] [3-SET BONUS]: Crouching for 5 seconds drops 5 standard magirockets. Every additional set piece worn will drop an additional 5 magirockets per call in. | 120s Cooldown

en: ''Those that did not listen were punished. Starved. Beaten. Our masters did not want to kill us as going back would be 'inconvienent'. In the worst cases, they would forcefully wipe the minds of those who resisted to the bitter end, leaving them nothing more than a robot. It was only a last resort because they wanted their servants to be more 'lively'.''
''You can only break the cycle for so long before death has decided enough is enough.''

asset: ^#efc565;Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy. (War Fairy - Gain 5 ^#C8FAFA;HIT-SHIELDS ^reset;^#efc565;with individual cooldowns. | 30s Cooldown. If all 5 fairy shields are broken at any point, gain one of five maluses for 30s and prevent any shield from recharging during this period. -50% HP | -50% General Resistance | -50% General Weapon Proficiency | -30% Movement Speed | Cannot DODGE)

field: ''순환을 깨뜨리는 것도 언젠가는 한계가 와. 죽음이 이제 됐다고 결정할 때까지는.''\n^#efc565;요정 순환 [4세트 보너스]: 전쟁 요정 획득. en: The Fairy Alliance consists of thousands of fairies who were drafted into the war. They are led by a select few long lived youkai who are rumored to have once been fairies themselves due to how easily they can control fairies to do what they want.

asset: ^#efc565;Magic Blast: Firing a muzzleloader, fires a shotgun cone of magishot that each deal 50 PSYCHIC damage at the closest enemy. | 10s Cooldown | +10% Muzzle Loader Proficiency.
Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.

field:
요정 연합은 전쟁에 징집된 수천의 요정으로 이루어져 있다. 그들은 소수의 장수 요괴가 이끄는데, 요정들을 원하는 대로 손쉽게 통제하는 솜씨 때문에 한때는 그들 자신도 요정이었다는 소문이 있다.
^#efc565;마법 폭발: 전장식총 발사 시 가장 가까운 적에게 사이킥 피해 50을 주는 매지샷 산탄 발사. | 재사용 대기 10초 | +10% 전장식 숙련.
요정 순환 [4세트 보너스]: 전쟁 요정 획득.
방어력: +30% 사이킥 & 열^reset;

en: The Fairy Musket Corps are made up of fairies who excel at long range marksmanship and have been given magilocks. While they still don't hold a candle to a tengu, these fairies stand as equals to the humans when it comes to marksmanship.

+7.5% Muzzle Loader Proficiency. Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy. DEF: +10% PSYCHIC & THERMAL^reset;

en: Fairies are divided into set roles dependant on their aspirations and attributes. Once they are given a role, they would be sent to the battlefield for 'orientation'. Only those who survive and remain mentally sound would be given training and be enlisted as a War Fairy.

en: Some fairies had occupations before the war as hard as it is to believe. Even if they only had the mindset of a child, proper discipline and promise of a reward can ensure that a fairy will be able to follow some directions. These fairies were the most likely to mature into a war fairy, as they stayed alive much longer than natural fairies.

asset: ^#efc565;Arrow Rain: Firing a bow or crossbow summons a portal above you which launches a volley of arrows toward the closest enemy. | 20s Cooldown | +50HP. Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.^reset;
field: 믿기 어렵지만 어떤 요정은 전쟁 전 직업을 가지고 있었다. 어린아이 같은 정신이더라도 적절한 훈육과 보상 약속이 있으면 요정도 지시를 따를 수 있었다. 이 요정들이 전쟁 요정으로 성장할 가능성이 가장 컸는데, 자연 상태의 요정보다 훨씬 오래 살아남았기 때문이다.\n^#efc565;화살 비: 활이나 석궁 발사 시 자신의 위에 차원문을 소환해 가장 가까운 적을 향해 화살 일제사격. | 재사용 대기 20초 | +50HP. 요정 순환 [4세트 보너스]: 전쟁 요정 획득.^reset;

en: ''A fairy's age tells you little of their maturity. You could see a fairy that's a thousand years old yet still be a complete and utter moron, or a fairy that just got reborn a few weeks ago be a disciplined trained soldier who has a foul mouth. Fairy's only mature when the environment force them to. Otherwise, they'll always be a naive fool.''

asset: ^#efc565;Oil Coating: Woodland bolts and arrows have a 10% chance to IGNITE enemies. Can be triggered by allies. Can only trigger once per enemy. +25HP. Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.^reset;
field: ''요정의 나이로 성숙도를 알 순 없어. 천 살인데도 완전히 멍청한 요정도 있고, 몇 주 전에 막 환생했는데 입이 거친 훈련된 병사인 요정도 있거든. 요정은 환경이 강제할 때만 자라. 그렇지 않으면 영영 순진한 바보로 남아.''\n^#efc565;기름 도포: 우드랜즈 볼트와 화살이 10% 확률로 적을 점화. 아군도 발동 가능. 적 한 명당 한 번만 발동. +25HP. 요정 순환 [4세트 보너스]: 전쟁 요정 획득.^reset;

en: ''The only difference between now and back then is that fairies die a lot more gruesomely.''

asset: A fairy's life cycle is a short one. Whether by their own stupidity or by something else, most fairies die at least once a month if they weren't under anyone's care. Since they are immortal, these deaths are often treated as nothing more than a annoyance.
^#efc565;Scout Vision: Nearby enemies will illuminate a bright light for 1s. | 10s Cooldown | +25HP. Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.^reset;

en: Strength alone will not be enough to survive frontline combat. One must also be resourceful as well. These War Fairies did not survive cause they were strong, they survived because they were willing to do anything to see the next sunrise.

asset: ^#efc565;Fairies In Arms: Swinging your melee weapon will call in two fairy knights which will perform a whirlwind attack across each side from you. | 20s Cooldown
Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.

field:
힘만으로는 최전선에서 살아남을 수 없다. 수완도 있어야 한다. 이 전쟁 요정들은 강해서 살아남은 게 아니라, 다음 해돋이를 보기 위해 무슨 일이든 했기에 살아남은 것이다.
^#efc565;전우 요정: 근접 무기를 휘두르면 요정 기사 둘을 불러 양옆에서 선풍 공격을 펼친다. | 재사용 대기 20초
요정 순환 [4세트 보너스]: 전쟁 요정 획득.

en: Out of all the other groups within the Fairy Alliance, knights have the highest casualty rate due to their role on the battlefield. They are also the most stalwart or headstrong bunch and are the last to break morale during a battle, making them the most reliable fairy anyone could rely on.

asset: ^#efc565;Body Shield: Killing an enemy within 10 blocks grants +100% SMALL-ARMS Resistance for 1s. | 5s Cooldown
Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.

field:
요정 연합의 모든 집단 중에서 기사는 전장 역할 때문에 전사자율이 가장 높다. 그들은 또한 가장 강직하고 완고한 무리로, 전투에서 사기가 무너지는 것도 가장 늦어 누구나 기댈 수 있는 가장 믿음직한 요정이다.
^#efc565;육신 방패: 10블록 내에서 적을 죽이면 1초간 소화기 저항 +100%. | 재사용 대기 5초

en: Despite wearing heavy armor, Fairy Knights are trained to use all their strength to force a close engagement with the enemy knowing that the alternative is death. Surprisingly enough, the same skills could be also useful for running away.

asset: ^#efc565;Close The Gap: If there are no enemies within 20 blocks when you are hit, gain +60% DODGE Chance, negate all ARMOR penalties, and gain +20% Movement Speed for 3s. | 30s Cooldown.
Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.

field:
중갑을 입었지만 요정 기사는 다른 선택지가 죽음뿐임을 알고 온 힘을 다해 근접전을 강요하도록 훈련받는다. 놀랍게도 같은 기술이 도망칠 때도 유용하다.

en: ''The longer a fairy lives, the more likely they are to die. There are entities that exist to ensure the natural order is maintained.''

en: ''Whatever fairy they used to be, they're long dead. All that's left in its place is a killing machine that will only see you with indifference behind that gold skull.''

asset: ^#efc565;Soul Harvest: If wearing a Fairy Assasin Fatigues, summon three Reapers instead of one when triggering Cheating Death. Reapers deal 25% less damage and no longer deal double damage to you.
Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.^reset;
field:
''그들이 어떤 요정이었든, 이미 오래전에 죽은 거야. 남은 건 그 자리에서 저 금 해골 뒤로 널 무심하게 볼 뿐인 살인 기계뿐이지.''

^#efc565;영혼 수확: 요정 자객 군복 착용 시, 죽음 속이기 발동 시 사신 하나가 아닌 셋 소환. 사신의 피해가 25% 감소하고 당신에게 두 배 피해를 주지 않는다.

en: ''They made their peace with the local yama. In fact, they've met her hundreds of times at this point. So when the war began and the yama realized she needed some extra hands, why not get their most common visitors to lend one?''

asset: ^#efc565;Spectres: If the target dies within 1 second after a Reaper attacked it, drop a floating wisp that grants random buffs for 5s.
Fairy Cycle [4-SET BONUS]: Gain War Fairy.^reset;
field:

en: ''The kappas are the only youkai we are aware of that can construct proper defenses against our armor. field: 근접 전투가 주 역할인 탓에 공병은 자주 기관단총이나 산탄총으로 무장하고 각종 수류탄을 지닌다. 게다가 폭발물과 밀접하게 일하므로 표준 제복의 일부로 갑옷도 지급된다.\n  \n^#b4a67f;탄도 저항 10%.^reset;

en: West Star sappers are engineers intended for a more frontline role rather than normal ones. Specializing in demolition and clearing the battlefield of hazards, the sapper stays close to the main infantry and ensures that no position holds them down.

asset: ^#b4a67f;Engineer Rigging: Negate the Medium Weight Weapon Penalty when using a Medium Weight Weapon. If using a Heavy Weight Weapon, halve the weapon penalty.

en: ''We've seen all sorts of things those youkai will put up to slow us down. Tree forts, bunkers, basic spike traps, the list goes long. The quality of the defenses depends on what youkai we're fighting. Kappas are known to make similar defenses like we do while the tengu tend to rely on more basic traps. Either way, it's a pain for us sappers to clear since we never fucking know what we're going to be dealing with next.''

asset: ^#b4a67f;Fate's Gamble: The next two bullets deals 10-90% less damage. | 20s Cooldown Each | DEF: +10% SMALL-ARMS | +15% EXPLOSIVE^reset;
field: ''요괴가 우리 속도를 늦추려고 갖가지 걸 내놓는 걸 봤어. 나무 요새, 벙커, 간이 창살 함정, 끝이 없어. 방어 시설의 수준은 우리가 상대하는 요괴에 달렸어. 캇파는 우리처럼 비슷한 방어 시설을 만드는 걸로 유명하고, 텐구는 더 단순한 함정에 의존하는 편이지. 어느 쪽이든, 다음에 뭘 상대하게 될지 도통 모르니까 우리 공병한테는 끔찍한 골칫거리야.''\n^#b4a67f;운명의 도박: 다음 두 발의 피해가 10~90% 감소. | 각 재사용 대기 20초 | 방어력: +10% 소화기 | +15% 폭발^reset;

en: Due to the close quarter nature of the sapper's combat role, sappers are often equipped with submachine guns or shotguns to defend themselves with along with a variety of grenades. Furthermore, sappers are given armor as part of their standard uniform due to their close work with explosive ordanance.

field: 근접 전투가 주 역할인 탓에 공병은 자주 기관단총이나 산탄총으로 무장하고 각종 수류탄을 지닌다. 게다가 폭발물과 밀접하게 일하므로 표준 제복의 일부로 갑옷도 지급된다.\n^#b4a67f;매설병: 적 근처에 있으면 매설에 5초 걸리는 아군 지뢰를 자기 위치에 설치. 매설 중 적이 접촉하면 파괴된다. | 재사용 대기 10초\n방어력: +10% 소화기 | +15% 폭발^reset;

en: ''Rise up and fight for your freedom! Join the volunteers today!''

en: The Rose Empire and its allies firmly believed that in the future, entrenched warfare would be the norm. Where soldiers would be stationed in neigh impenetrable fortifications, enduring the enemy's onslaught until having to come out of their bunkers to repel another senseless attack. They realized how wrong they were once the Lion's Battalion simply went around their fortresses.

asset: ^Orange;Man the Guns!: +15% Medium Weapon Proficiency | +30% Heavy Weapon Proficiency^reset;

en: ''Early months of the war had the Crow Tengu completely pushed back by the human's armored aircrafts. As the war progressed though and the Crow Tengu realized their superior mobility and magical abilities completely outmatched them as long as they avoided their initial attack run, the humans had no chance. Nowadays, the humans would only send out their air units under the protection of their flak guns so that any Crow Tengu that tried to intercept them would get shrapnel in their wings.''

field: ''전쟁 초기 몇 달간 까마귀 텐구는 인간의 장갑 항공기에 완전히 밀렸다. 전쟁이 진행되면서 까마귀 텐구는 첫 공격 항로만 피하면 자신들의 뛰어난 기동력과 마법 능력이 압도함을 깨달았고, 인간들에게는 기회가 없었다. 요즘은 인간들이 까마귀 텐구의 요격에 대공포 파편을 날개에 맞도록 대공포 보호 아래에서만 항공 부대를 내보낸다.''\n^Orange;이동 중 회피 +30%.^reset;

en: ''We've been promoted! What does that mean?''

asset: The L44 and L42F only recently entered production and were few and far between in the hands of a soldier. Lion high command only equips their best soldiers with these limited weapons knowing that there is no chance to replace them if they are lost in action.

en: Heavily armored engineer equipped with a flamethrower allowing the soldier to burn anything in their way. field: ''수류탄 돌격!!!''\n  \n신관 5초의 파편 수류탄. 총 5개의 수류탄이 한 자루에 대강 묶여 있다. 던지면 끈이 빠르게 풀려 수류탄 5개가 각종 각도로 날아가 단일 수류탄보다 훨씬 넓은 지역을 타격할 수 있다. 이 무기 전에는 라이온 보병 분대가 각 병사가 동시에 수류탄 하나씩을 던지는 게 일반 전술이었다.
